tei:div.tei:p: 325) ༄༅/ gzhi las 'phags pa'i gnas mchog na// rig 'dzin chos dpal bzang po la// sbyin pa mthar phyin 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir byin phob= bye brag phyed pa'i gnas mchog na// don dam lha yi dbang po la// tshul khrims rnam dag 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir= phyed thog grol ba'i gnas mchog na// nges don bstan 'dzin bzang po la// bzod pa rab brtan 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir byin phob= rang ngor snang ba'i snang mchog na// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la// brtson 'grus ldan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir byin phob= ngang las ma g.yos gnas mchog na// klong chen nam mkha'i rdo rje la// bsam gtan rtse gcig 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir byin phob= 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas mchog na// rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa la// shes rab rab gsal 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir= khyad chos drug ldan gnas mchog na// lha sras theg mchog mtshan can la// phyin drug rdzogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnas 'dir byin phob=
kha skong tshigs bcad bdun po ma ṇis so// bkra shis// 326)
